subject.title: fix(state): stop Voice Wake migration conflict startup loops

question: For installations where Voice Wake JSON and already-populated shared SQLite state disagree, should SQLite always remain authoritative and the legacy JSON be archived rather than keeping startup blocked for manual resolution?
rationale: This is a user-data conflict policy: the patch intentionally changes which existing persisted values remain active during upgrade, and tests alone cannot establish that the chosen authority rule matches maintainer product intent.

options.title: Adopt SQLite as the conflict authority
options.body: Accept the proposed rule that existing shared SQLite settings remain active and divergent legacy JSON is archived after successful handling.

options.title: Retain fail-closed manual resolution
options.body: Keep the existing warning-and-refusal behavior until a maintainer-approved interactive or Doctor conflict-resolution flow is designed.

recommendation.title: Adopt SQLite as the conflict authority
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed rule that existing shared SQLite settings remain active and divergent legacy JSON is archived after successful handling.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the available recent contributor for the exact migration path, though a repository owner should make the policy decision.
